name: Jubal
description: Man living at the time before the Flood

points: Jubal, of Cain's line, was the father of all that handle the harp and organ, dealing in the witchcraft of his father, not with God.
Worldly music is downloaded from the spirit realm; the spirit that operated in Jubal is what is in the earth's music.

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org
